expectations.text: ThemeProvider with brand='ionos' wraps the output
expectations.evidence: Line 275: `<ThemeProvider>` is used with no `brand` prop. The brand is set as a `data-brand="ionos"` attribute on the child `<main>` element (line 277), not as a prop on ThemeProvider itself. The assertion requires `brand='ionos'` on ThemeProvider.

expectations.text: ThemeInverter (or equivalent) is used for the dark hero section
expectations.evidence: Line 43: `<ThemeInverter forceColorScheme="dark">` wraps the entire HeroSection content.

expectations.text: Colors reference CSS custom properties (var(--...)) rather than hard-coded hex values
expectations.evidence: All color references throughout the file use CSS custom properties, e.g. `var(--brand/ionos-blue-900)`, `var(--neutral/white)`, `var(--brand/ionos-sky-300)`, `var(--brand/ionos-blue-800)`. One background uses `rgba(17, 199, 230, 0.15)` (line 57) for a semi-transparent overlay but all solid colors use var() tokens.

expectations.text: Hero section contains a Button component with a CTA label
expectations.evidence: Line 112: `<Button concept="brand" variant="primary" size="large" onClick={() => {}}>Get started for free</Button>` appears inside HeroSection.

expectations.text: Three Card components cover Web Hosting, VPS, and Domains (or equivalent)
